messages:
Priya S: Quick check-in. Need final scope for PRD: quota exemptions + billing edge cases. Customers want per-route exemptions, onboarding bursts, and safe retro credits. Deadline: EOD Friday.
Alex R: Can you enumerate asks so we can map to acceptance criteria?
Priya S: Sure — concise list: 1) Mark routes as quota-exempt (example: /v1/webhook/receive) 2) Temporary onboarding burst credits (X tokens/day for 30d) 3) Retroactive credits with audit trail + reason codes 4) Admin controls to apply exceptions and view impact 5) Exportable billing metadata (per-route breakdown).
Rob C: Technical note: per-route exemptions require adding route_id dimension in metering. Batching/caching may merge attribution; we need a robust propagation header.
Sara L: From finance/billing: retro credits must be auditable, queued for approval, and bounded. No open-ended refunds. Ops needs an approval workflow and reason codes.
Matt D: Proposed MVP (2 sprints): API-only exemptions (no Console), configurable burst credit packs per-tenant, billing event tags (billing_exemption, policy_id), manual credits via admin CLI (audited), CSV bulk import for rules, docs + acceptance tests.
Alex R: Perf targets: policy eval <1ms median, p99 <5ms overhead; overall p99 impact <5%. If failing, evaluate async policy application + reconciliation.
Rob C: Implementation sketch: evaluate policy at edge proxy via fast lookup; attach header `X-Quota-Policy: <policy-id>`; central metering records header per-event and batch envelope includes header so attribution survives batching.
Priya S: Console toggle was requested by customers. Proposal: post-MVP Console, but include temporary CSV import + API for launch.
Matt D: Acceptance criteria (to include in PRD):
- CRUD API for exemption policies
- Metering emits `policy_id` and `exempted` boolean for every invoiceable event
- Billing CSV export includes `exempted`, `exemption_reason`, `credit_memo_id`
- Admin CLI to create credit memos with reason code and `credit_memo_id`
- Safety defaults: `inherit=false`, `sample_rate` supported, auto-expiry mandatory
- Perf: meet Alex's latency budget
- Tests: end-to-end integration covering batching, cache, and attribution
Sara L: Pilot gating: start with 3 tenants; manual review of first N credits; legal sign-off on refund policy. Also add optional processing fee for backfills.
Rob C: Edge cases to call out in PRD:
- Fan-out webhooks: if inbound is exempted, downstream token usage should not automatically inherit unless `inherit=true` is explicitly set and admin approved. Default `inherit=false`.
- Partial exemptions: `sample_rate` used for staged rollouts (e.g., 10% exempt)
- Backfill: reprocessing historical logs to tag events is compute-expensive; limit to 90 days and require fee/approval.
Priya S: Example policy proto for engineers to include in PRD:
```
{"policy_id":"exempt-webhook-2026-03","scope":"tenant:acme","match":["/v1/webhook/receive"],"exempt_tokens":true,"inherit":false,"sample_rate":1.0,"duration":{"start":"2026-03-20","end":"2026-06-20"},"reason":"onboarding webhook traffic"}
```
Rob C: Add `sample_rate` optional field. Also include `created_by` and `audit_reference` in stored policy metadata.
Alex R: Risk summary for PRD: revenue leakage, performance regressions, metering complexity. Mitigations: limited pilot, auto-expiry, manual approval, exposure telemetry (estimated $ exposure per policy).
Matt D: Launch deliverables (PRD must include): API spec, proxy header contract, billing export schema, migration/backfill playbook, pilot plan, rollback steps, and acceptance test matrix.
Sara L: Billing export columns needed: `timestamp`, `tenant_id`, `route_id`, `tokens`, `exempted`(boolean), `exemption_reason`, `policy_id`, `credit_memo_id` (nullable), `processing_fee` (nullable). Add CSV schema to PRD.
Rob C: Migration/backfill plan: cap to 90 days, admin request flow, queue jobs with cost estimate, billing flag `backfill_processed=true`. Recommend charging processing fee or requiring approval to keep ops bounded.
Priya S: Roadmap: MVP (API + CSV + CLI credits) -> pilot -> Q2 Console toggle + historical audit UI. PRD to list rollout gates: telemetry stable, no major revenue delta in pilot, legal sign-off, and perf within budget.
Matt D: Action items:
- Rob: draft API schema + proxy header spec (due Thu)
- Sara: billing export columns + credit memo workflow (due Thu)
- Alex: perf targets and guardrail doc (due Thu)
- Priya: rollout playbook + pilot criteria (due Fri)
- Matt: merge acceptance criteria into PRD (I'll finalize)
BillingBot: Created ticket FIN-4578 for backfill fee approval assigned to Sara L.
LaunchBot: Pilot channel `#pilot-exemptions` created. :rocket:
Priya S: I'll assemble PRD draft and ping for final thumbs up. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
